arguments.name: B2BJ Masked charge
arguments.description: Rotate exact supplied masked swordsman and preserve pose: low coiled stance, knees bent, sword held BACK beside rear hip, preparing horizontal sweep. Preserve blue hair, ivory full-face mask with dark markings and red center dot, blue coat, beige collar, single straight silver katana. Same size and proportions. Do not replace pose with idle. Back view shows hair only. Transparent80x80, feet baseline72, no effects.
